title: Worksheet 2: Phishing Scams
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Phishing is a type of cyberattack in which criminals send fake emails, text messages, or other messages designed to trick people into revealing sensitive information, such as passwords, credit card numbers, or personal details. Phishing messages often pretend to come from a trustworthy source, such as a bank, a well-known company, or even a friend or coworker, and they frequently create a sense of urgency, warning that an account will be locked or a payment is overdue, to pressure the person into acting quickly without thinking carefully. Many phishing messages contain a link that leads to a fake website designed to look exactly like a real one, so when a person enters their username and password, the information is actually sent directly to the attacker. Some warning signs of phishing include misspelled words, generic greetings like "Dear Customer" instead of a real name, suspicious sender email addresses, and links that don't quite match the company's real website address.
